Heard Mr. Amit Buxy learned counsel for the Appellant and Mrs. Mandawi Bharadwaj P.L. for the State/ Respondent on the instant application under Section 389(2) of Criminal Procedure Code 1973 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail (I.A. No. 01/2023) By the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 05.04.2023, passed in Special Sessions Case no. 70/2022 by the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Janjgir, District Janjgir Champa, whereby the appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under Conviction Sentences Under Section 376(2)(n) 10 years R.I. and ine of Rs. 1,000/-, in of IPC default of payment of ine, 20 days additional R.I. Learned Counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in connection with the alleged crime.
It is further contended that the appellant is in custody since his date of arrest i.e. 30.07.2022.
Since the appeal with take some considerable time for its conclusion, therefore, the jail sentence as awarded by the Trial Court be kept in abeyance, till the disposal of this appeal.
On the other hand, learned counsel appearing for the Respondent/State has opposed the said application.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the records of the Court below.

Therefore looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and having considered the aforesaid contention of the parties, considering the nature of incident and act committed by the appellant particularly considering the conviction of the appellant under Section 376(2)(n) of IPC.

I am not inclined to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
